page_title: BRE 0-0 CHE | Brentford v Chelsea 06/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' A wild pass somehow finds Cole Palmer (Chelsea) in space, he steadies himself and shoots from mid-range but sends it just over the bar.
90+3' Michael Oliver blows his whistle and it's Christian Norgaard (Brentford) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. Chelsea will take a free kick near the side line.
90+2' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) is in acres of space inside the box and lets fly with a shot which goes well wide of the right post. What a poor effort.
88' A snap shot by Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Mark Flekken produces a good save to thwart him.
88' Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) connects with the resultant free kick but produces a header straight at Robert Sanchez.
87' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
85' Michael Oliver interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Trevoh Chalobah (Chelsea).
83' Thomas Frank prepares a substitution. Kristoffer Ajer is replaced by Michael Kayode (Brentford).
83' Mikkel Damsgaard goes off the pitch and Mathias Jensen (Brentford) comes on.
81' Mikkel Damsgaard delivers a perfect cross for Yoane Wissa (Brentford), who has simple job scoring from close range but somehow contrives to send the ball just wide of the right post.
80' Great ball in from Keane Lewis-Potter. Sepp van den Berg (Brentford) should really have done better with a close-range header, but he heads it a whisker over the crossbar.
80' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) takes it short.

79' Robert Sanchez pulls off a great save to deny Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the left side of the goal. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Brentford.
79' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
79' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The ball goes behind for a corner. Chelsea will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
77' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Sepp van den Berg (Brentford) was quite harsh and Michael Oliver didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
77' Here comes a substitution. Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) is brought on as a substitute for Reece James.
76' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mark Flekken intercepts the ball.
75' The attendance is 17183.
74' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar.
73' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.

72' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
70' Kevin Schade (Brentford) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
69' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
69' Reece James (Chelsea) commits a rough challenge and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul. Brentford earn a free kick.
67' Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
66' Substitution. Yegor Yarmolyuk will be replaced by Vitaly Janelt (Brentford).
64' Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
64' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the right post.

64' Reece James (Chelsea) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the top left corner. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
63' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) will deliver the corner kick.

63' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. Chelsea win a corner kick.
63' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) strikes from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball heads into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies him with a fantastic save.
61' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
61' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) attempts a lovely volley towards the top left corner of the net, but it's saved by the keeper. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea have been awarded a corner kick.
60' Michael Oliver has a clear sight and sees a foul from Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford). Chelsea have a free kick.
59' Enzo Maresca has decided to make a change. Cole Palmer (Chelsea) replaces Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall.
59' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Noni Madueke.

55' Trevoh Chalobah (Chelsea) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball goes well wide of the left post.
55' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) will take the corner.
54' A cross from Malo Gusto (Chelsea) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. Chelsea have a corner.
53' The corner is swung in but Chelsea can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

53' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. The ball is out of play and Chelsea manage to earn a corner.
51' Kevin Schade (Brentford) attempts to find Yoane Wissa, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea will have a goal kick.

49' Mark Flekken doesn't have to worry about this one. Enzo Fernandez plays a pass into the feet of Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea), who is unable to find the target as his effort from inside the box goes well wide of the left post.
49' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
48' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) makes a strong challenge and Michael Oliver blows for a foul. Brentford are awarded a free kick.
46' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford).
46' Half-time substitution. Enzo Maresca decided to make a change. Christopher Nkunku is replaced by Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea).
46' Referee Michael Oliver blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Reece James sends the free kick into the box. Tosin Adarabioyo (Chelsea) outjumps the defence to win the header, but completely mistimes the ball and sends it well wide of the left post.
45+2' Michael Oliver couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Sepp van den Berg (Brentford) and blew his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Chelsea.
45+1' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Brentford are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
45' Michael Oliver shows a yellow card to Tosin Adarabioyo (Chelsea) for his blatant foul.
41' Michael Oliver blows his whistle as Noni Madueke (Chelsea) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack. That's a free kick to Brentford.
39' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle. Brentford win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
39' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Chelsea.
38' Jadon Sancho (Chelsea) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball goes out for a corner. Chelsea can continue in their attacking effort.

37' Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the left side of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
36' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

36' Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) attempts to release Bryan Mbeumo with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players. Brentford have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
32' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Mark Flekken is equal to the effort and makes a good save.
32' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) races through the centre to the edge of the box then lets fly with a rocket of a shot that flies a whisker wide of the right post.
31' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) heads on.
30' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
28' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) plays a lovely through ball to Mikkel Damsgaard, but he can't beat Robert Sanchez and loses the ball.

27' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) attempts to threaten the goalkeeper from the free kick on the edge of the box. He produces a stunning blast which only flies inches over the crossbar. It could have been a beautiful goal!
26' A free kick on the edge of the box for Brentford. Let's see if they'll manage to convert it into a goal.
26' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Michael Oliver had an easy-decision to make.
25' Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Brentford have a free kick.
24' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) commits a foul and Michael Oliver immediately signals a free kick. It's a free kick to Brentford in a dangerous position.
23' Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Chelsea) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
21' Wow, what an escape. Yoane Wissa (Brentford) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
19' Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
16' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
15' The free kick is delivered by Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared. The ball is out of play. Brentford will have a chance to score from a corner.
13' Jadon Sancho (Chelsea) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
10' Reece James (Chelsea) tries to find Christopher Nkunku, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.
9' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) sends a chip pass into the box, but Mark Flekken is quickest to intercept the ball.
7' Michael Oliver blows the whistle, Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) is penalised for a foul. Chelsea are awarded the free kick.
5' A pass by Noni Madueke (Chelsea) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
3' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) doesn't hesitate to shoot inside the box after a neat pass from Bryan Mbeumo. It's a good effort but just misses the left post.
2' Reece James swings in the free kick towards Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea), who powers a header well wide of the left post from close in.
1' Kevin Schade (Brentford) commits a rough foul. Michael Oliver stops the game and makes a call. Chelsea have a free kick.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
